annotations.title: Request a missing chain or item

description: Tell the site operator that a restaurant chain or menu item is missing. Use only after search_menu / list_chains could not find it AND the user actually wanted it. One request per chain or item. Only the chain, item and note are stored (no personal information is needed or kept). Requests are counted (not shown publicly) and used to decide what to add next. Some chains do not publish nutrition values at all, so a request does not guarantee coverage.

chain.description: Restaurant chain name, e.g. 天下一品.

item.description: Menu item name, if a specific item is missing.

note.description: Optional short context, e.g. "seasonal item", "new menu from October".

name: request_missing
title: Request a missing chain or item
